calls.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production transparent native PNG sprite atlas for an English-learning app.
STYLE REFERENCE: attached user-supplied flat geometric cartoon sheet, STYLE ONLY. New corrected ADULT occupation people in that friendly graphic language. The user explicitly says the current people look evil, some are too thick, and some parts look disconnected. Correct those problems visibly.
FACE REQUIREMENT FOR EVERY PERSON IN EVERY CELL: approachable and warm, open round/oval white eyes and friendly black pupils, both eyebrows relaxed and gently curved upward like shallow soft arches, brows separated and never pointing down toward the nose. Clear upturned smiling mouth, kind expression, rounded nose, soft jaw corners. No scowl, inward V brows, thick dark slanted brow blocks, half-lidded stare, smirk, villain expression, pointed moustache, sharp teeth or tiny glaring eyes. Preserve adult appearance, not babies.
BODY REQUIREMENT: balanced ADULT proportions, roughly three to three-and-a-half head-heights tall, moderate shoulder width, visible neck, medium/slender connected limbs, hands smaller than the face, enough leg length. Some people slim, some average, a few moderately curvy/stocky; none massive, square, barrel-thick or inflated. Clean memorable soft geometric silhouettes with rounded corners.
FLATNESS: literal flat 2D cut-paper solid fills. Each material region has ONE uniform unshaded color. Palette magenta, teal, navy, orange, yellow, cream, varied warm skin and hair colors. No shading, gradients, darker undersides, highlights, shadows of any kind, ground marks, floor ovals, texture, hair shine, light source, modeled volume, outlines, 3D or background. A nose may be its own one-color shape. Native transparent alpha background.
ANATOMY: EXACTLY TWO ARMS PER PERSON. Every upper arm starts visibly at its shoulder; every forearm visibly meets its elbow; every hand overlaps and physically touches its wrist/sleeve. No gap, detached hand, extra hand, stray skin-colored fleck or sliver, duplicate limb, fused patient/doctor hand mass. All fingers belong to an attached hand. Held objects physically touch supporting palms/fingers in ALL four phases.
ANIMATION: four distinct meaningful connected arm/hand poses per row. Stable character face/body size, clothes, feet/base position and stationary props across columns; do not move the basket/desk/plant/car from side to side. Same limb lengths across all four phases. Keep the full person, hair, feet, both complete hands and every prop inside its cell, with at least 12% empty transparent gutters on all sides. No neighbor touching or cropped fingers.
No letters, words, labels, panel borders, grid lines or watermark.
LAYOUT: exactly FOUR COLUMNS by FOUR ROWS, sixteen full isolated scenes on a square transparent canvas. Each row repeats one job scene in four successive action phases.
ROW1 TEACHER: slim adult woman, warm tan face, burgundy soft side-swept bob, magenta jacket, cream blouse and navy trousers, orange shoes. Friendly relaxed eyebrow arches and warm open smile. Her LEFT arm continuously supports a small open teal book against her waist, palm touching its lower edge. Beside her a small blank teal board stays fixed. RIGHT arm phases: point low at board, point chest-height, point higher, open explanatory palm. Full connected arms, book never floats.
ROW2 CHEF: average adult man with only a moderately stocky build, NOT a wide barrel; peach face, small rounded navy moustache, friendly open eyes/relaxed arch brows, white chef hat, cream jacket, magenta neckerchief, navy trousers. Small teal pot on orange block counter remains fixed. LEFT hand continuously grips pot handle. RIGHT hand continuously GRIPS a long brown spoon visible above rim through four clearly different stirring phases: hand left/up, center/high, right/up, left/lower but still above rim. Both arms completely connected, moving forearm visible; do not hide it inside torso. Spoon always touches fingers.
ROW3 DOCTOR AND PATIENT: average slim dark-brown adult male doctor with short rounded black hair, relaxed gentle brows, warm smile, cream coat, teal stethoscope, navy trousers. Beside him sits an average-build peach-skinned adult woman patient with soft orange bob, magenta shirt, teal trousers and a simple stool. BOTH friendly smiling adult faces. Doctor LEFT dark-brown hand supports the woman's PEACH hand/wrist from beneath, with distinct visible shapes and clear connected sleeves; never recolor the patient's hand brown. Patient's other hand rests on her own thigh. Doctor RIGHT free arm phases: points to pulse, lightly checks above wrist, opens reassuring palm beside chest, touches his own chest reassuringly. Their contact area is small and readable, no merged multi-hand mass. Whole seated patient visible.
ROW4 OFFICE WORKER: average adult woman, soft peach/tan face, orange side-part hair, navy rounded rectangular glasses, gently arched brows and warm smile, teal blouse. Seated behind small fixed orange desk and teal laptop. Four connected arm phases: both typing, right hand at chin, right hand points to screen, left hand hovering over keyboard while right hand types. Shoulder/elbow/wrist routes readable, hands not giant. No legs or chair parts detached.
